ios.desc:
Have you got 2 or 3 Google accounts?

Work, personal, side projects — calendars all over the place, double bookings, endless copy-paste?

CalMirror automatically mirrors events between your multiple Google Calendars.

------------------

PERFECT FOR
• People with separate work and personal Google accounts
• Side hustlers who don't want freelance work showing on their main calendar
• Freelancers who want to share busy times — not details — with family
• Anyone working across multiple Google Workspaces

KEY FEATURES
• Auto sync events from Calendar A to Calendar X
• Replace titles and notes (e.g., "Client X meeting" → "Busy")
• Color conversion rules
• Filter out events you don't want to sync (Pro)
• Auto-delete sync (Pro)
• Run multiple sync rules in parallel (Pro)

FREE / PRO
• Free: 1 sync rule
• Pro ($3.99/month): Unlimited rules + filters + deletion sync

PRIVACY
• Calendar data is never stored on our servers
• Official Google OAuth 2.0 authentication

REQUIREMENTS
iOS 16+ / Google account

------------------
